destination.question: How do string-relevant degrees of freedom affect the approach to cosmological singularities, possible transitions through them and the validity of spacetime effective theory?
destination.summary: Keeps classical singularity dynamics, conjectured crossing and replacement of spacetime distinct within one overview.

systems: Gauge, matrix, orbifold and orientifold descriptions
regimes: Null and spacelike constructions, distinguished source by source
Approach to a singularity versus passage through it
assumptions: Truncation validity and coupling limits are construction-specific.
excludes: Inferring singularity resolution from classical asymptotics or finite matching variables

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a spacetime big bang be described by gauge degrees of freedom that become tractable when the string geometry fails? The reviewed null linear-dilaton construction exchanges early strong string coupling for weak worldvolume Yang–Mills coupling.

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: What replaces the classical description of a spacelike singularity in string theory, and can the associated divergences or closed timelike curves be controlled? The review compares several partial approaches without asserting a complete resolution.

sources.title: String excitation by initial singularity of inflation

evidence.text: Can an inflationary initial singularity invalidate a low-energy description through string excitation even when curvature invariants remain finite and the Hubble scale is below the string scale?

sources.title: Limitations of an effective field theory treatment of early Universe cosmology

evidence.text: Assuming superstring theory is fundamental, what limits the use of point-particle effective field theory in primordial cosmology, and which string-based alternatives might supply the missing description?

sources.title: String cosmology and the breakdown of local effective field theory

evidence.text: What conceptual limitations obstruct a local point-particle EFT description of the very early universe, and how might string gas, doubled-space and matrix-model approaches supply alternatives?

sources.title: Chaos in superstring cosmology

evidence.text: Does the complete massless bosonic field content of each superstring model and eleven-dimensional supergravity generically produce oscillatory BKL behavior or monotonic Kasner behavior near a spacelike cosmological singularity?

sources.title: From big crunch to big bang

evidence.text: Can a contracting universe pass through a=0 into expansion, with a collapsing compact dimension and weak string coupling near the transition? The central question is whether a fundamental theory can connect the singular classical branches.

sources.title: A Resolution of the cosmological singularity with orientifolds

evidence.text: Can localized negative-tension orientifolds replace the conventional spacelike big-crunch/big-bang singularity with cosmological horizons and permit well-defined propagation from a contracting to an expanding universe?

sources.title: Dimensional mutation and spacelike singularities

evidence.text: Can shrinking compact negatively curved Riemann surfaces lead to a supercritical string phase, replacing a cosmological spacelike singularity with more light degrees of freedom?

sources.title: Big Bang Models in String Theory

evidence.text: Can string degrees of freedom resolve cosmological singularities, permit meaningful propagation through a crunch/bang, or replace the singular spacetime description? These pedagogical proceedings focus on the Milne orbifold and matrix big bang rather than a comprehensive survey.

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Transfer a known electric-field oscillator realization to the twisted closed-string algebra, specifying the Hilbert space and ordering. This operation addresses fixed-background quantization; it supplies neither a unique spacetime vacuum nor a backreacted singularity resolution.

sources.title: String excitation by initial singularity of inflation

evidence.text: Introduce Gaussian damping away from the singularity to define asymptotic in/out vacua. Extract Bogoliubov coefficients through Wronskians, use a Born Fourier-transform estimate at large mode number, and supplement the divergent case with a junction-condition argument.

sources.title: Limitations of an effective field theory treatment of early Universe cosmology

evidence.text: Reviewed background constructions use doubled coordinates and a generalized metric, homogeneous α′ corrections, and anisotropic external/internal scale factors. The matrix proposal instead takes N→∞ with g²N fixed and extracts time and spatial blocks from Hermitian matrices.

sources.title: String cosmology and the breakdown of local effective field theory

evidence.text: String-gas correlation functions are obtained from its partition function. DFT introduces ordinary and winding-dual spatial coordinates with a generalised metric; dependence on only one coordinate set recovers the usual metric, antisymmetric-tensor and dilaton supergravity sector.

sources.title: Chaos in superstring cosmology

evidence.text: The stability exponents are g_ijk=1+p_i−p_j−p_k for distinct indices, e^(p)=Σ of p selected metric exponents − λ_p p_φ/2, and b^(p)=Σ of d−p−1 selected metric exponents + λ_p p_φ/2. Maxwell equations with spatial derivatives neglected give time-independent electric densities and magnetic components.

sources.title: From big crunch to big bang

evidence.text: Use Weyl transformations between Einstein, string and higher-dimensional metrics; solve the V=0 system analytically; and transform to finite variables a₀,a₁ or light-cone coordinates a± on minisuperspace.

sources.title: String Cosmology: A Review

evidence.text: How does string theory's ultraviolet structure inform spacelike singularities, inflationary model building, moduli dynamics and dark energy, and which resulting cosmological signals could constrain particular constructions?

sources.title: Time dependent orbifolds and string cosmology

evidence.text: Can time-dependent string orbifolds provide controlled descriptions of cosmological singularities, including propagation, gravitational backreaction and interactions? Can orientifold interpretations supply consistent boundaries and cosmological bounces?

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll at the Boundary of the Landscape

evidence.text: What prevents a compelling quantum description of cosmology in string theory? The appendix emphasizes time dependence, nonsupersymmetric backgrounds, singularities and cosmological observables, while arguing that current technical limitations are insufficient grounds to dismiss the program.

sources.title: A New cosmological scenario in string theory

evidence.text: Can collapsing and expanding cosmologies be connected through an intermediate region bounded by cosmological horizons, replacing the usual spacelike Big-Bang singularity, and can string winding degrees of freedom resolve the remaining singular behavior?

sources.title: Beyond Standard Inflationary Cosmology

evidence.text: What causal requirements must an early-universe structure-formation scenario satisfy, which inflationary and alternative paradigms realize them, and what tentative guidance does string theory offer concerning singularities and inflation?

sources.title: Pre - big bang in string cosmology

evidence.text: Can string dualities motivate an accelerated, growing-curvature phase preceding standard cosmology, replace the initial singularity, supply sufficient inflation, and leave observable relic gravitons?

sources.title: Superstring cosmology — a complementary review

evidence.text: Can string degrees of freedom and dualities support bouncing or emergent cosmologies with causal, nearly scale-invariant fluctuations, without extended inflation? Where does conventional EFT cease to describe the early universe?

sources.title: Lectures on string/brane cosmology

evidence.text: Can string and brane dynamics supply inflation or alternatives, explain primordial density perturbations, and address cosmological singularities? The lectures assess proposed mechanisms and their unresolved prerequisites.

sources.title: String Gas Cosmology

evidence.text: Review whether string degrees of freedom and dualities can describe cosmology before effective field theory applies, address singularity and dimensionality questions, stabilize moduli, and generate primordial fluctuations without inflation.

sources.title: String theory and primordial cosmology

evidence.text: How might string ingredients—duality, a fundamental length, dilaton and axion fields, and higher-dimensional brane interactions—alleviate primordial singularities, trans-Planckian physics and inflationary initial-condition problems? The chapter gives an introductory overview of proposed scenarios.

sources.title: Beyond Standard Inflationary Cosmology

evidence.text: What causal requirements must an early-universe structure-formation scenario satisfy, which inflationary and alternative paradigms realize them, and what tentative guidance does string theory offer concerning singularities and inflation?

sources.title: Random matrices and the spectrum of N-flation

evidence.text: What mass spectrum is typical for nondegenerate string-axion N-flation, and how do its mass spread and initial conditions affect inflationary dynamics and scalar perturbations?

sources.title: Gravitational wave constraints on Dirac-Born-Infeld inflation

evidence.text: Can the tensor and scalar predictions of DBI inflation satisfy compactification geometry and cosmological observations simultaneously, with constraints insensitive to the detailed potential and throat profile?

sources.title: A Delicate universe

evidence.text: Can explicitly computed interactions between a mobile D3-brane and moduli-stabilizing wrapped branes be fine-tuned to permit slow-roll warped brane inflation, while keeping the inflationary region inside a geometrically controlled throat?

sources.title: Chasing brane inflation in string-theory

evidence.text: Can D7-embedding-dependent threshold corrections cancel moduli-stabilization forces on a mobile D3-brane sufficiently to realize inflation driven by D3–anti-D3 Coulomb attraction? If cancellation is only local, can inflation occur and can the brane reach the tip?

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can a simple symmetric wrapped-brane embedding yield a stable radial path with locally small inflaton curvature? The Kuperstein cycle supplies an explicit holomorphic prefactor and a residual SO(3) symmetry.

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can a mobile D3-brane inflate after volume stabilization, wrapped-brane forces and geometric parameter correlations are included? The target is a construction derived from compactification data, with sufficient control to assess inflation and its predictions.

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Can a brane with relativistic local motion drive inflation through warping even when ordinary potential slow-roll conditions fail?

sources.title: Constraints on Wrapped DBI Inflation in a Warped Throat

evidence.text: Can a relativistic D5- or D7-brane wrapped on an internal cycle generate allowed inflationary observables within a stabilized warped compactification?

sources.title: Large Gravitational Waves and Lyth Bound in Multi Brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can interacting brane-position moduli produce an effective inflaton? In the reviewed heterotic construction, neighboring open-M2 instantons couple N M5-branes, and equal adjacent separations are reported to form a stable attractor.

sources.title: Monodromy in the CMB: Gravity Waves and String Inflation

evidence.text: Can wrapped-brane monodromy provide super-Planckian single-field inflation in string theory while preserving moduli stabilization and suppressing corrections to slow roll, with an observable tensor signal?

sources.title: Systematics of multi-field effects at the end of warped brane inflation

evidence.text: When can light residual angular fields generate significant curvature perturbations and non-Gaussianity at the end of warped brane inflation, and do those conditions actually produce an effect in the explicit Kuperstein-embedding case study?

sources.title: Warped Wilson Line DBI Inflation

evidence.text: Can a Wilson-line inflaton with DBI kinetic terms in a warped compactification satisfy theoretical and cosmological consistency bounds while producing both substantial non-Gaussianity and observable tensor perturbations?

sources.title: Combined local and equilateral non-Gaussianities from multifield DBI inflation

evidence.text: Can angular fluctuations modulate the tachyonic end of radial D-brane inflation, generating curvature perturbations with both local and equilateral bispectra, and does their coexistence predict a distinctive trispectrum component?

sources.title: Low-scale Inflation and Supersymmetry Breaking in Racetrack Models

evidence.text: Can a single-modulus racetrack model support inflation with Hinf∼m3/2∼30–50 TeV, acceptable primordial perturbations and early gravitino decay, and what constraints would this place on visible-sector soft masses?

sources.title: Gauged M-flation, its UV sensitivity and Spectator Species

evidence.text: Does the light spectator spectrum lower the gravitational cutoff enough to invalidate gauged M-flation, and are its scalar inflationary trajectories stable within the proposed D-brane-motivated effective description?

sources.title: Modulated Reheating and Large Non-Gaussianity in String Cosmology

evidence.text: Can an explicit string-inflation construction support a light field that modulates visible-sector reheating, dominates primordial curvature perturbations, and produces appreciable local non-Gaussianity while avoiding curvaton contributions?

sources.title: Fluxbranes: Moduli Stabilisation and Inflation

evidence.text: Can fluxbrane inflation be combined with controlled moduli stabilization while satisfying the paper's historical curvature-perturbation and cosmic-string constraints, preserving an inflaton flat direction and avoiding an effectively constant FI term?

sources.title: D7-Brane Chaotic Inflation

evidence.text: Can a D7-brane position modulus realize large-field monodromy inflation in a four-dimensional supergravity description while conventional flux and nonperturbative effects stabilize the remaining moduli?

sources.title: D7-Brane Moduli Space in Axion Monodromy and Fluxbrane Inflation

evidence.text: Under what geometric, flux, and quantum-correction conditions can a D7-brane deformation remain sufficiently light for inflation, and can fluxbrane inflation coexist parametrically with Kähler-moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Higgs-otic Inflation and String Theory

evidence.text: Can the neutral MSSM Higgs sector drive chaotic-like inflation through string monodromy, while leaving a fine-tuned light SM Higgs and controlling corrections during trans-Planckian field excursions?

sources.title: Large field inflation from D-branes

evidence.text: Can D-brane-generated F-term axion monodromy provide large-field inflation with an inflaton lighter than stabilized moduli, controlled stabilizer dynamics and a flattened potential at trans-Planckian field values?

sources.title: Modulated Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Can string-motivated higher instanton harmonics preserve trans-Planckian aligned axion inflation, satisfy the mild weak gravity conjecture, and change the CMB predictions of natural inflation?

sources.title: The IR Obstruction to UV Completion for Dante's Inferno Model with Higher-Dimensional Gauge Theory Origin

evidence.text: How do massive-vector constraints from the IR obstruction to UV completion restrict a higher-dimensional realization of Dante's Inferno inflation, and when can quartic potentials approximate explicit 5-brane DBI examples?

sources.title: Higgs-otic Inflation and Moduli Stabilization

evidence.text: Can large-field D7-brane inflation remain controlled after stabilizing the closed-string moduli, accounting for backreaction on both the scalar potential and the canonical inflaton distance?

sources.title: Fibre Inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: How does LVS fibre inflation realize α-attractor dynamics, which values of α arise, how do string corrections limit the plateau, and can effective supergravity capture stabilization, inflation and its exit?

sources.title: Monodromy Charge in D7-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Does the internal backreaction of charge induced on a moving D7-brane generate inflaton-dependent nonperturbative moduli potentials strong enough to obstruct Higgs-otic inflation?

sources.title: Fat inflatons, large turns and the $\eta$-problem

evidence.text: Can radial and angular motion of a wrapped probe D5-brane realize the all-heavy, rapidly turning inflationary mechanism?

sources.title: Non-Minimal M-flation

evidence.text: Can nonminimal coupling to gravity improve matrix inflation's observational predictions, reduce the required D3-brane multiplicity, enable spectator preheating and alleviate excursions beyond the proposed UV cutoff?

sources.title: Fundamental Physics, the Swampland of Effective Field Theory and Early Universe Cosmology

evidence.text: Can primordial fluctuations originate thermally in a long, quasi-static high-density phase rather than from vacuum fluctuations during accelerated expansion?

sources.title: Gravitational wave constraints on Dirac-Born-Infeld inflation

evidence.text: Integrate the displacement–tensor relation along the actual trajectory, then compare the excursion with an independently bounded field interval. For an observable interval with nearly constant r, replace the integral by √(r_*/8)Δ𝒩_*.

sources.title: A Delicate universe

evidence.text: Use the imported position-dependent superpotential W=W0+A(z)e^−aρ, with a=2π/n and A(z)=A0[f(z)/f(0)]^(1/n), together with K=−3 log U and U=ρ+ρ̄−γk. The local conifold Kähler potential is k=3r²/2; the resulting F-term potential is supplemented by the anti-D3 contribution.

sources.title: Chasing brane inflation in string-theory

evidence.text: Compute the N=1 supergravity F-term potential and extremize the axion, volume and angular directions for a general embedding. Large-volume expansion gives the leading angular condition ∂α|f|=0; the uplift and D3 displacement shift the volume minimum.

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Integrate the known throat contribution to a gluing cutoff, then parameterize inaccessible bulk geometry. This gives leading-volume relations; interpreting a fluxed D7 gauge coupling additionally requires checking its magnetic contribution.

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Specify component equations of state and initial densities, integrate conservation separately, sum densities, and integrate the Friedmann equation. Equality epochs follow by equating component densities rather than by assuming continued single-component dominance through the transition.

sources.title: Constraints on Wrapped DBI Inflation in a Warped Throat

evidence.text: Factor the world-volume determinant, integrate the wrapped directions and redefine the radial scalar. Retain the full G-B determinant until the physical inputs justify a dominance limit.

sources.title: TASI lectures on cosmological observables and string theory

evidence.text: How can string theory's ultraviolet structure constrain inflationary mechanisms and observable primordial correlations, and what does cosmological uplift of holographic duality suggest about a framework for accelerating universes?

sources.title: String Cosmology: A Review

evidence.text: How does string theory's ultraviolet structure inform spacelike singularities, inflationary model building, moduli dynamics and dark energy, and which resulting cosmological signals could constrain particular constructions?

sources.title: String Cosmology

evidence.text: These lectures review how string theory might accommodate a small cosmological constant and inflation, emphasizing moduli stabilization, obstacles to flat inflaton potentials, possible remedies, and observational signatures.

sources.title: Swampland distance conjecture, inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: Does a string scalar potential near an infinite-distance singularity have the regularity needed for α-attractor inflation, in addition to the matching kinetic structure?

evidence.text: Can an inflationary initial singularity invalidate a low-energy description through string excitation even when curvature invariants remain finite and the Hubble scale is below the string scale?

sources.title: String Gas Cosmology

evidence.text: Review whether string degrees of freedom and dualities can describe cosmology before effective field theory applies, address singularity and dimensionality questions, stabilize moduli, and generate primordial fluctuations without inflation.

sources.title: Challenges for superstring cosmology

evidence.text: Can the paper's 1992 'current superstring lore' support inflation and lead cosmologically to a vacuum with zero or small cosmological constant and time-independent Newton constant?

sources.title: A string-inspired running-vacuum-model of cosmology, primordial-black-hole dark matter, and the current tensions in cosmological data

evidence.text: Can a string-inspired running-vacuum cosmology connect anomaly-driven inflation, primordial-black-hole and axion dark matter, and possible alleviation of the H0 and structure-growth tensions discussed in this 2023 review?

sources.title: String theory and primordial cosmology

evidence.text: How might string ingredients—duality, a fundamental length, dilaton and axion fields, and higher-dimensional brane interactions—alleviate primordial singularities, trans-Planckian physics and inflationary initial-condition problems? sources.title: Solution of the Size and Horizon Problems from Classical String Geometry

evidence.text: Can a previously constructed classical string-cosmology background solve the Standard Big Bang size and horizon problems while satisfying the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture, and how does its accelerated stage transfer scalar perturbations?

sources.title: Anomalies, the Dark Universe and Matter-Antimatter asymmetry

evidence.text: Can a string-inspired cosmology with torsion and early gravitational anomalies connect inflation, axion or primordial-black-hole dark matter, gravitational-wave signatures and matter–antimatter asymmetry? This conference review summarizes a proposed framework and earlier model studies.

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Cosmology at the Theory Frontier

evidence.text: How can cosmology acquire a microphysical UV and IR completion explaining acceleration, inflationary observables, and cosmic-horizon entropy? This Snowmass review surveys string constructions, cosmological EFT, holography, and model-dependent observational tests.

sources.title: The dangerous irrelevance of string theory

evidence.text: How does string theory participate in empirical cosmology through ultraviolet sensitivity, inflationary mechanisms, and effective-field-theory guidance for observational searches?

sources.title: Inflation and String Theory

evidence.text: How can inflation arise as a controlled low-energy consequence of string theory, and which cosmological observables can constrain its ultraviolet origin?

sources.title: Inflation in string theory confronts data

evidence.text: What did the 2015 CMB constraints imply for string inflation mechanisms, and which tensor, spectral-feature, non-Gaussianity and null-result searches could further constrain their microscopic physics?
